import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int MAX_N = 210;
    static final int[][] DIRS = {{0, 1}, {0, -1}, {1, 0}, {-1, 0}};

    static class Edge {
        int to, w, next;
        Edge(int to, int w, int next) {
            this.to = to;
            this.w = w;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAX_N * MAX_N];
    static int n, t, source, sink;
    static int[][] capacities = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] sciences = new int[15][15];
    static int[][][] maze = new int[65][15][15];
    static int[] head = new int[MAX_N];
    static int edgeCount;
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[15][15];
    static boolean[][][][][] reachable = new boolean[65][15][15][15][15];

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int w) {
        edges[edgeCount] = new Edge(v, w, head[u]);
        head[u] = edgeCount++;
        edges[edgeCount] = new Edge(u, 0, head[v]);
        head[v] = edgeCount++;
    }

    static int[] dist = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] current = new int[MAX_N];

    static boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        current[s] = head[s];
        dist[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; ~i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
                int v = edges[i].to, w = edges[i].w;
                if (dist[v] != 0 || w == 0) continue;
                dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                current[v] = head[v];
                q.offer(v);
                if (v == t) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int t, int flow) {
        if (u == t) return flow;
        int rest = flow, i;
        for (i = current[u]; ~i != 0 && rest != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
            int v = edges[i].to, w = edges[i].w;
            if (w != 0 && dist[v] == dist[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = dfs(v, t, Math.min(rest, w));
                if (pushed == 0) dist[v] = 0;
                edges[i].w -= pushed;
                edges[i ^ 1].w += pushed;
                rest -= pushed;
            }
        }
        current[u] = i;
        return flow - rest;
    }

    static int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int result = 0, flow;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            while ((flow = dfs(s, t, INF)) != 0) {
                result += flow;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int getId(int x, int y, int k) {
        return (x - 1) * n + y + k * n * n;
    }

    static void dfsReach(int startX, int startY, int curX, int curY, int step) {
        visited[curX][curY] = true;
        reachable[step][startX][startY][curX][curY] = true;
        if (step >= t || maze[step][curX][curY] != 0) return;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = curX + DIRS[d][0], ny = curY + DIRS[d][1];
            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > n || ny > n) continue;
            if (visited[nx][ny] || maze[step][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
            dfsReach(startX, startY, nx, ny, step + 1);
        }
    }

    static void preprocess() {
        Arrays.fill(current, 0);
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        edgeCount = 0;
        for (int timeStep = 1; timeStep <= t; ++timeStep) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                    if (maze[timeStep - 1][x][y] != 0)
                        maze[timeStep][x][y] = maze[timeStep - 1][x][y];
                    else {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = x + DIRS[d][0], ny = y + DIRS[d][1];
                            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > n || ny > n) continue;
                            if (maze[timeStep - 1][nx][ny] == 2)
                                maze[timeStep][x][y] = 2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (sciences[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x)
                        Arrays.fill(visited[x], false);
                    dfsReach(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int step = 1; step <= t; ++step)
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x)
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y)
                    for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; ++xx)
                        for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; ++yy)
                            reachable[step][x][y][xx][yy] |= reachable[step - 1][x][y][xx][yy];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) sciences[i][j] = c - '0';
                else if (c == 'Y') maze[0][i][j] = 1;
                else if (c == 'Z') maze[0][i][j] = 2;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) capacities[i][j] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        source = n * n * 2;
        sink = source - 1;
        preprocess();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (sciences[i][j] != 0) addEdge(source, getId(i, j, 0), sciences[i][j]);
                if (capacities[i][j] != 0) addEdge(getId(i, j, 1), sink, capacities[i][j]);
            }
        }
        for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x)
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y)
                for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; ++xx)
                    for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; ++yy)
                        if (sciences[x][y] != 0 && capacities[xx][yy] != 0 && reachable[t][x][y][xx][yy])
                            addEdge(getId(x, y, 0), getId(xx, yy, 1), INF);
        System.out.println(maxFlow(source, sink));
    }
}
